title: Stage-change confirm: a flow that reaches an approval through a subflow is listed without the approval mark
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oLLK7uoxp33riiBJL

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding while building #35928 (PR #36316, os-dev-report 7075034362 on #35928, open question 2). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.
Dedupe: `subflow approval`, `startsApproval`, `record-starts subflow` (open: only #35928 itself and seat posts). No card covers it.

## What happens (as the dev measured it on the PR head 0658fbc5; not yet on `main`)

- PR #36316 adds the read `POST /api/v1/automation/_record-starts`. Each listed flow carries `startsApproval`, set when the flow itself has a node of type `APPROVAL_NODE_TYPE` (the literal reading of ruling 7073655354 on #35928: "approvals marked").
- `showcase_project_closure` reaches its approval through a subflow, so a member moving a showcase project to completed sees it listed without the approval mark, although the change does start an approval.

reach: any record update whose matching flow starts an approval only inside a called subflow. Lands when PR #36316 merges.

## Ask

- Decide whether the approval mark follows subflows (the flow's own nodes plus the flows it calls, with a depth or cycle guard), and if so make `startsApproval` true for such flows, reusing the one approval test. ⛔ No second approval rule.
- If triage reads this as a change to what ruling 7073655354 says, it goes to the maintainer as a decision first.
- Pins: a flow whose subflow holds the approval is marked; a flow calling a subflow with no approval is not; a self-calling flow ends.

Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/record-update-starts.ts`) · area:ux · Bug.
